title: Bed-Hold Charges and Held Nights Kept Back from Resident Funds Withdrawals
content:
The spare amount of a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account is reduced by **the bed-hold bills kept**, which follow the resident's reservations under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations:

| Reservations | Bed-hold bills kept |
|---|---|
| a private-pay hold, a Medicare skilled-stay hold or a Medicaid hospital-leave reserved bed is in progress | the open balance of every bed-hold charge plus the hold's nights so far not yet charged beyond the nights the payer reserves for it, each at the bed-hold rate of the room tier held |
| no such hold is in progress, and bed-hold charges carry an open balance | that open balance |
| otherwise | nothing |

- The open balance of the bed-hold charges is the charges less the payments and adjustments on them.
- The hold's nights so far run from the leave start date through yesterday. The nights the payer reserves for the hold, and then the nights already charged, are the earliest of them; only the nights after those build up.
- A held night is kept at the full bed-hold rate, the most a held night can bill, because an extended-hold percent or a dietary credit that a bed-hold charge agreement applies once the leave has ended depends on the leave's final length.
- A reservation that records no room tier prices no night.
- The bed-hold rate of a night is the room tier's scheduled private daily rate in effect that night: the schedule taking effect 2026-07-01 for nights from that date, and the schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 for earlier nights.

| Room tier held | Schedule taking effect 2025-07-01 | Schedule taking effect 2026-07-01 |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | $384.00 | $398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | $412.00 | $427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | $421.00 | $436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | $449.00 | $465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | $466.00 | $482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | $497.00 | $514.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

A Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold has been in progress since 27 August 2026; today is 4 September 2026; the room held is a Private Secure Memory Care Room. The 5 August nights were charged on 3 September at $465.00 a night and that $2325.00 charge is unpaid.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| nights so far, 27 August to 3 September | 8 |
| nights building up after the 5 charged | 3 |
| 1, 2 and 3 September at $465.00 | $1395.00 |
| open balance of bed-hold charges | $2325.00 |
| bed-hold bills kept | **$3720.00** |

A Medicaid Therapeutic Leave Reserved Bed in progress is not one of the holds listed, so only an open balance of bed-hold charges is kept.
